### Install

**macOS** — download the `.dmg`, drag Prompt Deck to Applications.
The build is not notarised by Apple, so the first launch needs
**right-click → Open** (or: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Prompt Deck.app"`).

**Windows** — download the `-setup.exe`. SmartScreen may warn about an
unknown publisher: *More info → Run anyway*.

Later versions install themselves — the app checks this release page
on launch and offers the update in-app.
